training.method: class-balanced 96-to-609-to-326-to-120-to-8 ReLU MLP over an ordered pair of measured temporal feature windows per speed signal; inactive production units pruned with zero fitted-bank logit drift

source.title: UPATRAS Rotating Machinery Vibration Dataset for Incipient Fault Diagnosis under Varying Rotating Speeds
source.acquisition: 39 independent measurement sequences; 2,925 single-axis vibration signals; 1,024 Hz; 75 rotating speeds from 35.0 to 49.8 Hz; healthy plus seven incipient fault states.
source.use: Production variable-speed neural head with an eight-condition learned representation, a healthy-versus-anomaly product boundary, and whole-measurement-sequence grouped validation.
source.changes: Two deterministic 2,048-sample windows per signal and RotorNote 48-feature vectors. Source sequence names preserve all eight observed laboratory conditions for representation learning; the product output collapses them to healthy versus observed anomaly without presenting laboratory condition names as field diagnoses.

training.validationProtocol: four-fold stratified whole-measurement-sequence cross-validation; no speed signal or feature window from a held sequence is used in training

decisionPolicy.basis: conservative observed grouped-CV floor; output scores are not field-calibrated failure probabilities

ood.method: mean squared normalized-feature distance to nearest real-training broad class centroid
